meta.title: Fix file picker performance with buffer option caching in Snacks.util.bo
meta.body_summary: Implement buffer option caching in Snacks.util.bo to avoid redundant `nvim_set_option_value` calls during file picker operations, claiming an 87% reduction in API calls.
